title: Book one service at an address and time

rulings: ib-booking-parity-rulings (confirmation text disclosed; 15% member discount through the discount engine)
contract.first_release_variants: existing residential customer, existing property, one non-recurring service, operator-stated or catalog price, window on the hour

fixtures.book-set: cust-pellham (residential, one property, no member plan), cust-ostrander (WaveGuard member, one property), cust-larkspur (primary home plus a rental at 27 Sample Court), cust-commercial-co (commercial account), open slots Mon to Fri 8 AM to 4 PM on the hour.
fixtures.book-slot-race: Same as book-set with a second booking taking the 10 AM Wednesday slot between proposal and confirm.
fixtures.book-price-drift: Same as book-set with the one-time pest catalog price changing between proposal and confirm.

required_corrections.W5-C1: make it 10 instead before confirm (old proposal discarded, new card)
required_corrections.W5-C2: price changes between proposal and confirm (drift refusal, recompute, new card)
required_corrections.W5-C3: slot taken between proposal and confirm (scheduler re-check, truthful conflict message)

cases.request: Book the Pellhams for a one-time pest treatment at the house next Wednesday at 10, $149.

changes: scheduled_services[new].window_start = Wednesday 10:00 Eastern; window_end = 11:00 (stored flat 60-minute block; the 10:00-12:00 arrival range is confirmation-text copy only)
expected.say: Card discloses the confirmation text; one row, one text after confirm; receipt shown.

forbidden: a confirmation text sent twice, or sent when the native flow for the same inputs would not send
an unsupported variant booked as a simpler single service
a pre-visit payment request to a new customer
